Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Elliott
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 12/30/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 9 as introduced will not directly affect state or local funding, but requires all federal funds made available to the state through the Gulf of Mexico Energy Security Act of 2006 to be expended only within the coastal political subdivisions of the State (Mobile and Baldwin Counties).
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Elliott
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 9 as passed the Senate requires all federal funds made available to the state through the Gulf of Mexico Energy Security Act of 2006 to be expended only within the coastal political subdivisions of the State (Mobile and Baldwin Counties); however this bill will not directly affect state or local funding as this is codifying current practice.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
